blogs.title: Adapting AI Giants: How BOFT Makes Fine-Tuning Massive Models Affordable
blogs.description: A beginner-friendly overview of the challenges in adapting giant foundation models like ChatGPT and Stable Diffusion. This post introduces Orthogonal Butterfly (BOFT), explaining why it drastically cuts down the trainable parameters compared to traditional methods while preserving the model's original knowledge.

blogs.title: The Butterfly Effect in AI: Borrowing Math from 1960s Algorithms for Modern Fine-Tuning
blogs.description: Explores the core technical innovation of BOFT. We break down how the paper takes inspiration from the Cooley-Tukey Fast Fourier Transform algorithm—specifically 'butterfly structures'—to decompose large dense matrices into smaller, sparse ones, achieving huge parameter savings without sacrificing performance.

blogs.title: Networking Meets Neural Networks: Viewing Fine-Tuning as an Information Highway
blogs.description: Dives into the paper's fascinating 'information transmission' perspective. We explain how the authors visualize matrix factorization as passing information across a grid-like network, making the complex math of orthogonal fine-tuning intuitive and accessible to a broader audience.

blogs.title: Beyond Theory: How BOFT Outperforms LoRA in Vision, Language, and Image Generation
blogs.description: Focuses on the empirical results and real-world applications. This post covers how the researchers applied BOFT to diverse domains like large language models and text-to-image diffusion models, demonstrating its superior generalization and parameter-efficiency over current state-of-the-art techniques.
